notes.title: Post launch update 1
notes.notes:
Hello! Here are the patch notes:

-Added smooth rotation option under gameplay settings
-Updated game difficulty to make the game just a bit easier

Just that for now, more as it gets suggested. Awesome!

notes.title: Percy Parcel is out now!
notes.notes:
Percy Parcel is on steam.

The game is playable start to finish with achievements, funny stuff, everything works beginning to end.

I'm going to use this moment now to say thank you to each and every person I've spoken to on steam, discord, wherever. I'm going to add/change a few tiny things in the game but I'm gonna keep going after this, see where it leads me. Thank you everyone.

Now, just to write this down, I'm also working on the first quick patch for the game. Your saves should be fine, but this patch will adjust some difficulty slightly, make the game a bit easier, and add some stuff if I can do it quick enough. Just want to adjust some things I think will make the gameplay experience a bit smoother and more enjoyable, but the game is fine right now as it is.

This should be out sometime tomorrow but who knows, let's just see how it works out.

Any suggestions are welcome. Despite wanting to move onto my next thing, I'll gladly fix and patch up what I can. Expect a patch at some point tomorrow, and have a nice day!
